description.value:
Frequency 2/day (+1 at 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th)

Named targets in the area take 6d6 damage (8d6 at 5th, 10d6 at 9th, 12d6 at 13th, 14d6 at 17th) as the Anchor is wrenched against — no attack roll; a Named target resists with a basic Will save. Allies in the area can't be possessed or Anchored themselves until the start of your next turn.

duration.value: until the start of your next turn

cinderfall.incomplete: The card's own prose never names a damage type for this burst -- defaulted to force (the standard PF2e placeholder for unspecified magical damage) since no other type is stated anywhere in the text. The level-gated damage increase (8d6 at 5th, 10d6 at 9th, 12d6 at 13th, 14d6 at 17th) also isn't automated: PF2e's heightening mechanism scales by spell rank, not character level, and this corpus has no rule-element equivalent for a level-gated spell-damage increase. Only the base (6d6, as cast at 1st level) value rolls automatically in Foundry; a GM needs to manually bump the die count at the stated character-level thresholds.
